Act as the review sub-agent for this task.

Read-only design cross-judge. Read /tmp/bend-vulkan-design/candidate-{1,2,3}/design.md fully. User wants Bend Vulkan wrapper like ash using Giulio2002/bend-collections U64. Rubric 1 real Bend ABI compatibility 2 ash-like reusable explicit operations 3 lifetime/forgery/error cleanup rigor 4 small extensible API 5 verifiability and native integration, each 1..5. Choose base and useful grafts, short report only; no edits/subagents. Parent prefers Data token handles with native validated registry, copy-based read/write (no exported mapped pointers), Entry.with cleanup. Discovery+buffers+one-shot GPU fill subset. ABI discovery: CID macros cannot refer imported aliases in 2.0.37. Thus tokens may be monotonic U32 registry IDs (never Vulkan raw handles, never reused; fail at wrap); all actual Vulkan sizes/offsets use upstream W.U64; native returns limb tuples converted into W.U64 by pure Bend boundary adapter. Judge these adjustments too.
I’ll read all three designs, score them against the rubric, and assess the proposed ABI adjustments.

content.text:
Choose **candidate 3** as the base: its Data references, scoped cleanup, and copy-based memory operations best match the preferred interface.

Scores for designs as written, each out of 5:

| Candidate | ABI | Explicit operations | Lifetime/error rigor | Small/extensible API | Verification | Total |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 3 | 5 | 4 | 3 | 4 | 19 |
| 2 | 3 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 19 |
| 3 | 3 | 4 | 4 | 5 | 4 | 20 |

Useful grafts:

- **From 1:** richer queue configuration, binding validation, and explicit completion checks before cleanup once submission exists.
- **From 2:** physical-device interning, pinned dependencies, precise compiler-ABI smoke tests, and simpler duplicate-destruction errors. Avoid its reserved wrapper-error code range; retain candidate 3’s distinct error variants.
- Normalize candidate 3’s scope helper to **`Entry.with`**, preserving callback errors alongside cleanup diagnostics.

**Approve both ABI adjustments.** Monotonic U32 IDs are sufficient registry references: reserve zero, allocate globally across Entry trees and reloads, never reuse IDs, and fail cleanly at exhaustion. Validate kind, ancestry, liveness, and resource state before driver access. IDs prevent pointer fabrication; they do not provide access control.

Keep every Vulkan size/offset as upstream **`W.U64`** publicly. Native limb tuples plus pure Bend reconstruction avoid `CID(W.U64)`. Audit effect registration and every other constructor reference for the same imported-alias problem; verify emitted canonical CIDs with a compiled smoke test containing a nonzero high limb.

**Required scope correction:** all three omit the requested GPU fill. Add a reusable one-shot fill on an existing buffer with caller-selected queue, then submit, establish completion, perform cache handling, and verify exact copied readback. Track temporary command resources through failure cleanup. A host-memory roundtrip alone does not validate that feature.
